## Description {#details}

<p>Pointer to the context, with optional RAUW support.</p>


<p>Either a raw (non-null) pointer to the <em><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/llvmcontext">LLVMContext</a></em>, or an owned pointer to <em><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/replaceablemetadataimpl">ReplaceableMetadataImpl</a></em> (which has a reference to <em><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/llvmcontext">LLVMContext</a></em>).</p>


<p>Definition at line 972 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/metadata-h">Metadata.h</a>.</p>
